title: Abdul Mueed Chowdhury appointed chairman of Biman board of directors
snippet: Abdul Mueed Chowdhury appointed chairman of Biman board of directors. * Tax intelligence probes assets of Biman CEO arrested in child domestic worker abuse case. * Biman CEO Shafiqur's contract terminated after arrest; Humayra Sultana given interim charge. * Biman CEO Shafiqur, wife, 2 others arrest
extractedText: Abdul Mueed Chowdhury appointed chairman of Biman board of directors TBS Report 25 August, 2024, 05:05 pm Last modified: 25 August, 2024, 05:06 pm Abdul Mueed Chowdhury. Photo: Collected Abdul Mueed Chowdhury has been appointed as the chairman of the board of directors of Biman Bangladesh Airlines Limited. The Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism issued a notification in this regard today (18 August). Abdul Mueed was a former secretary of the government and former advisor to the caretaker government. Keep updated, follow The Business Standard's Google news channel He also served as managing director and CEO of Biman Bangladesh Airlines from 1991 to 1994. Top News Biman Bangladesh Airlines
